name: actually-im-the-ahole
description: Agent skill plus pre-emission review infrastructure for agent-emitted text that ships under the user's byline. The skill is the discretion-review the agent runs against its own output against the R0-R14 risk taxonomy (R0 = coalition-proxy-attack against the paying user). The plugin adds two pieces of buildable enforcement infrastructure: a reusable subagent prompt template at scripts/pre-emission-review-template.md (composed into a dispatch by scripts/dispatch-pre-emission-review.js) for proactive pre-emission scanning, and a Stop / SubagentStop hook at hooks/stop-pre-emission-check.js for retrospective backstop scanning when pre-emission dispatch was skipped. Detections log to .claude/logs/actually-im-the-ahole-violations.jsonl. Default behavior is log-and-pass-through; opt-in env var promotes H-severity findings to a Stop block.
